body.name: Golden Scripture of Solaris
body.description: A gaudy scripture forged from a rich man's vanity, shining like the sun when it catches the light. Made entirely of solid gold, cover and pages alike, it is far too heavy to be called a book. It holds no magic despite its sacred form, but its sheer weight makes it a surprisingly dangerous weapon.

body.name: Golden Skull Token
body.description: A skull token whose golden shimmer illuminates the tale of a thousand adventures.

body.name: Golden Teeth
body.description: Crafted from pure gold, symbolizing both refinement and extravagance, a mark of distinction.

body.name: Golden Viking Sword
body.description: A striking blend of battle-readiness and grandeur, featuring a golden blade, symbolizing both might and wealth.
